subject: Legal runway: MSA setup & initial redline request — HelioHealth
messages:
From: Sam Green <sam@helioshealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: MSA and PO attached — ready to begin contracting

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is our standard PO and the MSA we use for vendor onboarding (Helio_MSA_Draft_v2.docx, Helio_PO_20270515.pdf). We'd like to move quickly and have finance route the PO by end of next week if possible.

Quick context: HelioHealth is doing a pilot with Redwood for ingesting clinical notes into a standardized embeddings pipeline. Key asks from our side upfront:
- Data residency: US-only processing required (no EU/UK residency)
- Minimum SLA expectations for 99p latency on embedding calls (pilot tolerance: 500ms overall)
- Standard NHS/PHI-like safeguards — we can provide an internal data map after NDA

Can you confirm who on your side will own the MSA redline and what the typical TAT is for an initial review? Also flag if you require a PO before we begin redlines.

Sam Green
Head of Procurement, HelioHealth
Sam Green | sam@helioshealth.com
Attachments: Helio_MSA_Draft_v2.docx (docx), Helio_PO_20270515.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and PO attached — ready to begin contracting

Sam — thanks and great to kick this off. Appreciate the attachments.

Quick answers:
- Owner for redlines: Contracts ops will manage the assembly and routing (cc'd: Marissa). Legal will do the substantive review (cc'd: Kimberly).
- TAT: Typical initial redline turnaround is 3–5 business days after we receive the PO + any security artifacts (SOC2 / DPA) that affect the DPA/Security exhibit. If we need an expedited review we can compress to ~48 hours but we'll need decision authority on the key commercial points.
- PO before redlines: We can start a review without a PO, but finance prefers an executed PO for billing and to prioritize procurement workflows. If you expect the PO to land, we'll hold the slot for your team.

To help us scope the redline, please confirm the following ASAP:
1) Which legal entity will sign for HelioHealth (full legal name and signer title).
2) Billing contact and billing address.
3) Any required exhibit for PHI/regulated data or an NDA you want incorporated.
4) Expected annual commitment (ballpark) so we can route to the right approval lane (under $250k vs. >$250k).

Kimberly / Marissa — looped you both in for priority. Next step for us: Marissa will capture an intake sheet and Kimberly will provide a short list of legal priorities to flag in their draft.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Green <sam@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and PO attached — ready to begin contracting

Ben / Marissa / Sam —

Thanks for the context, Sam. Quick checklist from Legal to help prioritize redlines on the Helio draft:
- Data residency / processing location: If Helio requires single-region (US-only) processing, we need the specific regions/accounts and whether data may be replicated for disaster recovery.
- Indemnity & liability cap: Identify whether Helio will request an exceptions-based higher cap or carveouts for regulatory fines.
- SLA & service credits: We will confirm what level of credits is commercially acceptable; ask whether the pilot SLA is a firm requirement vs. aspirational.
- Audit rights & security questionnaires: If Helio requires on-site audits or a broad audit scope, expect pushback; SOC2 report + completed vendor security questionnaire usually satisfies most asks.
- Data classification & PHI: If Helio will supply PHI, we need an executed DPA + any PHI-specific exhibit.

Please provide: SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 deadline), a completed vendor security questionnaire, and the preferred signer entity. If Helio cannot share SOC2, we can run on alternative evidence (pen test summary, SSP).

Timeline guidance: once we receive the PO + security artifacts, Legal will do an initial pass and flag material commercial exceptions within 3 business days. For anything routing above $250k we’ll need our commercial approvals team which may add 2 business days.

I've attached our short redline guidance doc for external teams (redline_guidance_template.pdf) — Marissa will use this when assembling the internal redline packet.

Kimberly Park
Lead Counsel, Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: redline_guidance_template.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Intake: HelioHealth MSA — initial redline packet & next steps

Sam — looping back with the intake notes and an initial internal marked copy.

Summary of what we received:
- Helio attached: Helio_MSA_Draft_v2.docx, Helio_PO_20270515.pdf (receipt confirmed).
- Outstanding artifacts requested: SOC2 Type II or equivalent, completed vendor security questionnaire, confirmation of signing entity, billing contact.

Internal notes (high level):
- Redline priorities to surface to Helio: data residency specifics (want explicit US-only clause if required), limitation of liability language aligned to Redwood template, carveouts for regulated fines unclear — flag for discussion, SLA credit calculation needs clarity.
- If Helio confirms pilot commitment and expected spend is < $250k, we can treat as standard route. > $250k will trigger commercial approval as Kimberly noted.

Attached is our initial marked packet (ben_initial_marked_redlines.pdf) that compiles Ben's notes + preliminary legal flags. This is internal — Sam, we will produce a clean tracked-changes version for you after we get the SOC2/DPA and signer confirmation.

Next steps / asks for Helio: please reply with the three items Kimberly listed and confirm the signer name/title. Also tell us the expected go-live window (pilot start) so we can prioritize scheduling.

Thanks — we’ll standby for the artifacts and will aim to get a redline turnaround within 3 business days after receipt.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
